S1.1.title: One-to-One Correspondence
S1.1.lo: Child can perform one-to-one physical matching between two small sets of real objects.

S1.2.title: Classification (Single Property)
S1.2.lo: Child can sort a small set of objects correctly by a single named attribute.

S1.3.title: Perceptual Same/Different
S1.3.lo: Child correctly identifies two sets as visually same or different without counting.

S1.5.title: Counting Small Sets (1–3) with Support
S1.5.lo: Child counts a set of 1–3 objects accurately with support.

S1.6.title: Shape Matching (Perceptual)
S1.6.lo: Child correctly matches two identical real-world shapes visually.

S1.7.title: Perceptual Subitizing
S1.7.lo: Child correctly states the quantity of 1–3 objects shown briefly, without counting aloud or pointing.

S2.1.title: Quantity Comparison (More/Less/Equal)
S2.1.lo: Child correctly identifies which of two groups has more, less, or whether they're equal.

S2.2.title: Seriation (3 Objects)
S2.2.lo: Child correctly orders 3 objects by a single given rule.

S2.3.title: Classification (Increasing Complexity)
S2.3.lo: Child sorts a larger/more varied set correctly by one named attribute.

S2.4.title: Counting to 5 with Cardinality
S2.4.lo: Child counts up to 5 objects and correctly states the total.

S2.5.title: Counting 6–10 with Support
S2.5.lo: Child counts 6–10 objects accurately with support.

S2.6.title: Shape Identification (Named)
S2.6.lo: Child correctly names circle, square, and triangle when shown.

S2.7.title: Simple Repeating Pattern (2-Item)
S2.7.lo: Child correctly continues a 2-item repeating pattern.

S2.8.title: Comparative Vocabulary (Informal)
S2.8.lo: Child correctly uses comparative measurement vocabulary when comparing two real objects.

S2.9.title: Conceptual Subitizing
S2.9.lo: Child correctly states the total of a small set (~4–6) by recognizing sub-groups, without counting one by one.

S2.10.title: Shape Composition: Piece Assembly *(added 2026-07-19)*
S2.10.lo: Child combines 2-3 shapes into a simple picture through trial and error.

S3.2.title: Numeral–Quantity Correspondence
S3.2.lo: Child correctly matches a written numeral to a counted set of that quantity, and vice versa.

S3.3.title: Numeral Comparison (Object-Mediated)
S3.3.lo: Child correctly compares two numerals when allowed to ground each in counted objects.

S3.4.title: Seriation with Transitivity
S3.4.lo: Child correctly orders 3+ objects and can answer a transitivity question without re-comparing every pair.

S3.5.title: Classification (Flexible)
S3.5.lo: Child correctly re-sorts the same set of objects by two different attributes in turn.

S3.6.title: Sequencing (Arranges by Sequence)
S3.6.lo: Child correctly arranges a small set of numbers or objects in sequence.

S3.7.title: Comparative Vocabulary (Formalizing)
S3.7.lo: Child consistently and correctly uses comparative measurement vocabulary across multiple items.

S3.8.title: Patterns (2-Item Independent + 3-Item Introduction)
S3.8.lo: Child independently continues a 2-item pattern and, with support, continues a 3-item pattern.

S3.9.title: Shape Properties (Basic)
S3.9.lo: Child can state at least one defining property of a basic 2D shape (e.g. "a triangle has 3 sides").

S3.10.title: Shape Composition: Picture Making *(added 2026-07-19)*
S3.10.lo: Child plans and creates a simple picture from multiple shapes, with some intentionality beyond pure trial and error.

S4.1.title: Numeral Comparison — Fully Abstract
S4.1.lo: Child correctly compares two bare numerals without needing objects.

S4.2.title: Numeral Comparison — Close Values
S4.2.lo: Child correctly compares two close-valued numerals.

S4.3.title: Counting Objects to 20
S4.3.lo: Child counts up to 20 objects accurately.

S4.4.title: Reading/Writing Numbers to 99
S4.4.lo: Child correctly reads and writes any number 1–99.

S4.5.title: Place Value — Face Value Only (Pre-Conceptual)
S4.5.lo: Child correctly names the two digits of a given 2-digit number.

S4.6.title: Addition to 9 (Concrete → Abstract)
S4.6.lo: Child solves addition problems with sums up to 9.

S4.8.title: 3D Shape Properties
S4.8.lo: Child correctly names corners, edges, and surfaces of a solid shape.

S4.9.title: Length Estimation (Non-Standard Units)
S4.9.lo: Child estimates and verifies an object's length using a body-referenced unit.

S4.10.title: Capacity Estimation (Non-Standard Units)
S4.10.lo: Child estimates and verifies a container's capacity using an informal unit.

S4.11.title: Patterns, 3-Item Repeating Cycle (Independent)
S4.11.lo: Child independently continues a 3-item pattern, including filling in a missing middle term.

S4.12.title: Zero, as "None"/Empty Set
S4.12.lo: Child correctly identifies zero as the count of an empty set, in context.

S4.13.title: Ordinal Numbers
S4.13.lo: Child correctly names and uses ordinal positions 1st–10th.

S4.14.title: Number Line Placement (Informal, 0–20)
S4.14.lo: Child approximately places a given numeral (0–20) on a blank number line.

S4.15.title: Shape Composition & Decomposition *(added 2026-07-19)*
S4.15.lo: Child both composes a new shape from parts and decomposes a given shape into parts.

S5.1.title: Reading/Writing Numbers to 999
S5.1.lo: Child correctly reads and writes any number 1–999.

S5.2.title: Place Value — Tens as Groups (Unitising)
S5.2.lo: Child explains a 2-digit number in terms of groups of ten plus ones (e.g. "47 is 4 tens and 7 ones").

S5.3.title: Flexible Decomposition of 2-Digit Numbers
S5.3.lo: Child can express a 2-digit number in more than one valid decomposition.

S5.4.title: Addition to 99, with Carrying
S5.4.lo: Child correctly solves 2-digit addition problems requiring carrying.

S5.5.title: Subtraction to 99, Introducing Borrowing
S5.5.lo: Child correctly solves 2-digit subtraction problems requiring borrowing.

S5.6.title: Multiplication as Repeated Addition
S5.6.lo: Child correctly represents a multiplication fact as repeated addition.

S5.7.title: Division as Equal Sharing
S5.7.lo: Child correctly shares a set of objects equally among a given number of groups.

S5.8.title: Multiplication Tables 2, 3, 4
S5.8.lo: Child recalls multiplication facts for tables 2, 3, and 4 fluently.

S5.9.title: Currency Recognition (Informal)
S5.9.lo: Child correctly identifies common Indian coins and notes.

S5.10.title: Informal Fractions via Folding
S5.10.lo: Child correctly folds/identifies half and quarter of a physical object.

S5.11.title: Length/Capacity, Non-Standard *Uniform* Units
S5.11.lo: Child measures an object using a uniform non-standard unit and gets a consistent result.

S5.12.title: 2D Shape Identification (Named Set)
S5.12.lo: Child correctly names rectangle, triangle, circle, and oval when shown.

S5.13.title: Spatial Vocabulary
S5.13.lo: Child correctly uses spatial-relationship vocabulary to describe object positions.

S5.14.title: Calendar, Days/Months
S5.14.lo: Child correctly reads days and months from a calendar.

S5.15.title: Object/Picture Sorting
S5.15.lo: Child correctly sorts and counts objects/pictures by category.

S5.16.title: Number-Sequence Patterns
S5.16.lo: Child correctly continues a repeating number-sequence pattern.

S5.17.title: Zero, as Place-Value Placeholder
S5.17.lo: Child correctly explains why a zero is needed in a number like 40, not just "4 with nothing after it."

S5.18.title: Number Line Placement, Extended (0–100)
S5.18.lo: Child approximately places a given numeral (0–100) on a blank number line.

S5.19.title: Skip Counting by 2s and 5s
S5.19.lo: Child correctly continues a skip-counting sequence by 2s or 5s.

S6.1.title: Place Value — 3-Digit Extension
S6.1.lo: Child correctly decomposes a 3-digit number into hundreds, tens, and ones.

S6.2.title: Place Value — Flexible 3-Digit Decomposition for Arithmetic
S6.2.lo: Child can decompose and recombine 3-digit numbers by place to support arithmetic.

S6.3.title: Comparison/Ordering of 3-Digit Numbers Using Place-Value Logic
S6.3.lo: Child correctly orders a set of 3-digit numbers using place-value logic.

S6.4.title: Reading/Writing to 9999
S6.4.lo: Child correctly reads and writes any number 1–9999.

S6.5.title: Addition/Subtraction to 999, Daily-Life Word Problems
S6.5.lo: Child correctly solves 3-digit addition/subtraction word problems.

S6.6.title: Multiplication Tables 2–10
S6.6.lo: Child recalls multiplication facts for tables 2 through 10 fluently.

S6.7.title: Division Facts
S6.7.lo: Child correctly recalls division facts corresponding to tables 2–10.

S6.8.title: Length/Weight/Capacity — Standard Units
S6.8.lo: Child correctly measures using standard units and reads standard measuring tools.

S6.9.title: Relating 2D Shapes to 3D Shapes
S6.9.lo: Child correctly identifies which 2D shapes make up the faces of a given 3D shape.

S6.10.title: Clock Reading — Hours and Half-Hours
S6.10.lo: Child correctly reads an analog clock to the hour and half-hour.

S6.11.title: Money Arithmetic (Rupees/Paise)
S6.11.lo: Child correctly adds and subtracts rupee/paise amounts.

S6.12.title: Half/One-Fourth/Three-Fourth — of a Whole and of a Collection
S6.12.lo: Child correctly identifies half/one-fourth/three-fourth of both a shape and a collection of objects.
S6.12.topics: Formal fractions, of a whole and of a collection.

S6.13.title: Pattern Rules + Skip-Counting by 10
S6.13.lo: Child correctly states the rule governing a pattern, not just its next term, and skip-counts by 10.

S6.14.title: Tally Charts, Pictographs, Bar Graphs (Up to 4 Categories)
S6.14.lo: Child correctly reads and interprets tally charts, pictographs, and bar graphs with up to 4 categories.

S7.1.title: Place Value — Extending to Thousands
S7.1.lo: Child correctly explains the place value of thousands in a 4-digit number.

S7.2.title: Reading/Writing Large Numbers; Regrouping
S7.2.lo: Child correctly reads, writes, and regroups 4-digit numbers.

S7.3.title: Complex Addition/Subtraction, Carrying Across Multiple Digits
S7.3.lo: Child correctly solves multi-digit addition/subtraction word problems requiring multiple regroupings.

S7.4.title: Multiplication Tables to 15; Multi-Digit Multiplication
S7.4.lo: Child correctly multiplies up to 2-digit×2-digit numbers.
S7.4.topics: Multiplication tables to 15 (unverified conventional scope); multi-digit multiplication (externally verified).

S7.5.title: Formal Division — 4 Methods
S7.5.lo: Child correctly solves division problems using at least two of the four named methods.

S7.6.title: Numerical Fraction Notation + Equivalence
S7.6.lo: Child correctly writes fractions numerically and identifies at least one equivalent pair.

S7.7.title: Unit Conversion (m↔cm, km↔m)
S7.7.lo: Child correctly converts between related standard units (e.g. 100cm = 1m).

S7.8.title: Measurement Word Problems (All 4 Operations)
S7.8.lo: Child correctly solves word problems involving length/weight/capacity using all 4 operations.

S7.9.title: 3D Shapes — Cube, Cuboid; Nets (Introductory)
S7.9.lo: Child correctly identifies the net of a simple 3D shape (cube or cuboid).

S7.10.title: Hours, Minutes, Time Intervals, AM/PM
S7.10.lo: Child correctly reads a clock to the minute and calculates simple time intervals, using AM/PM correctly.

S7.11.title: Complex Money Word Problems
S7.11.lo: Child correctly solves multi-step word problems involving money.

S7.12.title: Number Patterns, Rule Identification
S7.12.lo: Child correctly identifies and states the rule for a more complex number pattern.

S7.13.title: Bar Graphs — Reading and Interpreting
S7.13.lo: Child correctly reads and interprets a bar graph, including comparison questions across categories.

S7.14.title: Factors & Multiples *(added 2026-07-19)*
S7.14.lo: Child correctly lists factors and multiples of a given number, and identifies common factors/multiples of two numbers.

S7.15.title: Decimals (Introduction) *(added 2026-07-19)*
S7.15.lo: Child correctly reads, writes, and compares simple decimal numbers (tenths and hundredths).
S7.15.topics: Decimal numbers; tenths; hundredths; decimal place value.

S7.16.title: Angles *(added 2026-07-19)*
S7.16.lo: Child correctly identifies and classifies the four named angle types.

S7.17.title: Symmetry & Reflection *(added 2026-07-19)*
S7.17.lo: Child correctly identifies symmetrical figures, draws a line of symmetry, and completes a missing symmetrical half.
S7.17.topics: Symmetry; line of symmetry; reflection; mirror images.

S7.18.title: Perimeter & Area *(resolved 2026-07-19 — was a flagged gap, not a node, until now)*
S7.18.lo: Child correctly calculates both perimeter and area of simple rectangles/squares and explains the difference between them.
